svg.title: Chi-Jiun Wong (翁祺鈞)
svg.desc: CS undergrad at NCU, minor in finance. Builds verifiable-ML prototypes and small bots that run on free tiers. Motto: the world is one giant makeshift troupe, so fake it till you make it. Animated banner: a client update is clipped, noised and proven, as in zk-verifiable-dp-fl.
